About the University
About the Department
Manonmaniam Sundaranar University (MSU), established in 1990 in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, serves the
southern districts of Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Kanyakumari and Tenkasi. Named after Tamil scholar and poet
Manonmaniam Sundaram Pillai, the university is committed to providing inclusive and quality higher education,
especially in rural and socially diverse areas. MSU offers Undergraduate, Post graduate and Ph.D. programs through its
departments, affiliated colleges, and distance education mode. With over 112 affiliated colleges, 6 University Colleges
and a 550 acres eco-friendly campus, the University promotes academic excellence, research, and holistic
development. Accredited with an 'A+' grade by NAAC and recognized by the UGC under Sections 12(B) and 2(f), MSU
plays a key role in fostering innovation, skill development, and socio-economic progress in the region.
The Department of Commerce at Manonmaniam Sundaranar University, Tirunelveli, is a vibrant academic
centre committed to excellence in commerce education and research. It offers M.Com (Accounting and Finance),
M.Com (Integrated), and Ph.D. programs with specializations in accounting, finance, taxation, marketing,
entrepreneurship, and business management. The curriculum blends theoretical knowledge with practical skills to
meet the evolving needs of industry and academia. The department is supported by experienced faculty engaged in
active research and academic contributions. It fosters holistic development through seminars, workshops, industrial
visits, and training programs, while also emphasizing entrepreneurship, ethical business practices, and financial
literacy. Through innovative teaching and a strong research culture, the department equips students with the skills and
knowledge needed for professional success and regional socio-economic development.

“UGC NET/SET EXAMINATION”
About the workshop
Objectives of the workshop
The UGC-NET/SET examination is one of the most competitive examinations for aspirants seeking to qualify for
the positions of Assistant Professor and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and to pursue careers in higher education and
advanced research. Success in these examinations requires a strong understanding of the syllabus, systematic
preparation, regular practice, effective time management, and appropriate examination strategies. Many aspirants,
especially those from rural areas, face difficulties in preparing for these examinations and are often unsure about where
to start, what to study, and how to study. Keeping this in mind, the Ten-Day UGC-NET/SET Workshop is designed to
provide intensive, systematic, and result-oriented training to aspiring candidates.
The programme will cover both Paper I and Paper II, providing participants with comprehensive guidance across
the major areas of the examination. Throughout the ten-day programme, participants will receive expert guidance,
conceptual learning, examination strategies, practice sessions, and valuable tips for effective preparation.
• Understand the syllabus, examination pattern, and weightage of different units in Paper I (Teaching and
Research Aptitude) and Paper II (Commerce).
• Strengthen their conceptual knowledge across all ten core areas of Commerce, along with Teaching and
Research Aptitude.
• Develop the ability to solve numerical and conceptual questions through practice using previous-year question
papers and mock tests.
• Develop effective time-management, revision, and examination strategies to improve their performance in the
UGC-NET/SET examination.
• Postgraduate students aspiring to become Assistant Professors
• Researchers and research scholars seeking to qualify for the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF).
• Candidates preparing for the UGC-NET/SET examinations in Commerce
